question: Does the task2593 terminal-target-local-lambda TD update transfer to one fresh complete Generic rule, relative to ordinary TD(lambda=.95) and matched initialization, at equal paid nodes?

rule.remaining_fields: GeneratorConfig defaults exactly as pinned source; no retries or substitute seed.
admission: One generated ruleset only; schema roundtrip and full generic compiler succeed.
Complete schema fields include piece types, initial position, drop and promotion rules, repetition limit, max ply, stalemate result, board size and metadata.
Non-anchor type IDs are exactly A,P,X; K is the sole anchor; at least one non-anchor piece is promotable with a valid target.
Initial position is nonterminal and has legal actions; at least 24 of the 32 frozen four-ply evaluation roots are nonterminal and have legal actions.
Failure of any admission criterion is retained as seed failure; no replacement seed or outcome-based rule selection.
rule.training_root_families: 500000..508191 (8192 deterministic families; each family is used at most twice per arm, same paired sequence across methods).
rule.evaluation_root_families: 510000..510031; both candidate colors per family; exact serialized histories must be unique and have zero overlap with every TRAIN root before fitness.

learner.scale_and_initialization: Fixed scale with first weight 1.0; for each seed initialize remaining five weights as task2565 random.Random(seed).uniform(0.5,1.5). Share exactly the same initial vector between methods.
learner.candidate: Exact task2593 OutcomeGatedTDLeafEpisode eta=0.05, base lambda=0.95; lambda=1 only for a bootstrap residual whose next observed complete search target has pv_terminal=true. Final known W/L residual uses .95. UNKNOWN is censored; incomplete searches are not observations.
learner.search: D2 plain search; 8192 nodes and at most 2 seconds per query; H=128; no specialized WIN prover; same ordering construction and tie/randomization policy across methods.

training.arms: Two methods per seed; each gets exactly 1,000,000 paid search nodes; same initial vector and same deterministic four-ply root family sequence within seed.
training.opponent: Fixed uniform six-channel weights [1,1,1,1,1,1], both roles balanced by alternating learner color.
training.censoring: No draw imputation. UNKNOWN, uncompleted game, and partial arm remain explicit; no cap extension. Count and report terminal-target residuals per method/seed.

evaluation.slots: 32 fresh four-ply roots x 2 candidate colors x 4 training seeds x 3 endpoints (initial, TD(.95), local-lambda TD) = 768 paired slots.
evaluation.search: Same D2 plain search, 8192 nodes/2 seconds per query, H=128; actual complete Generic rules and history-aware game execution.
evaluation.unknown_and_missing: Retain UNKNOWN/missing/partial slots; use conservative paired reward bounds [-1,+1]. No result-driven reruns or cap extension.

audits: Source/config/rule hashes and full-history root manifests frozen before fitness.

Replay every recorded training and evaluation action through the pinned rule engine; verify legal actions, state immutability on search, terminal source, history, actor/role, model weights, nodes and outcome accounting.
Independent replay/root-overlap audit and one bounded unpruned rule-authority sample; cap 600 seconds total.

transfer_candidate_only_if: Each method has at least 128 terminal-PV target residuals pooled over its four seeds; report per seed.
Finite paired W-L reward lower bound is strictly positive for local-lambda endpoint minus ordinary TD endpoint.
Finite paired W-L reward lower bound is strictly positive for local-lambda endpoint minus its matched initial weights.
decision_rule.otherwise: Retain all partial/failure results; do not migrate the update beyond this rule, tune parameters, select seeds, or inspect these evaluation roots for another attempt.
decision_rule.interpretation: A finite one-rule transfer result only; not a population, all-rules, stable-order, or universal GenericChess claim.

cost.basis: task2592 1.6M Generic train nodes in 547.03s and 1024 eval slots in 284.75s.
cost.projection: 8M train nodes about 2735s; 768 eval slots about 214s; plus <=600s audits and packaging overhead; planned pipeline cap 5100s (<120m).
cost.threshold: Expected run remains <120 minutes; if recalculation reaches >=120m, submit necessity assessment to Dot before launch. Do not split to evade or extend any cap.
